company.name: Findly (YC S22)
company.shortDescription: Findly helps businesses understand and interact with their data by providing the business intelligence.
company.description:
Findly is The AI Chatbot for Your Data.
Get accurate, actionable data insights in minutes without needing to learn SQL or Python. Ask questions in plain English and see results that are easy to understand.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform that converts natural language queries into SQL and visual insights, enabling users to interact with business data without technical expertise.
productsAndServices.name: Findly AI

productsAndServices.description: A co-pilot tool that automates the creation and maintenance of the semantic layer by inferring business metrics and dimensions from data warehouses.
productsAndServices.name: Semantica

productsAndServices.description: A user interface that visualizes data insights generated by Findly AI, offering interactive visualizations, metadata transparency, and error handling.
productsAndServices.name: Findly Dashboard

productsAndServices.description: An AI chatbot integrated with communication platforms like Slack and Teams that enables users to query data sources such as Google Analytics and Facebook Ads using natural language.
productsAndServices.name: Findly AI Chatbot Integration

productsAndServices.description: A program offering agencies tools, support, and resources to integrate Findly's AI data analytics into their client services.
productsAndServices.name: Agency Partnership Program
